recognize_zh: 骨髓切片細胞密度高，可見大量成群、核圓、細染色質、帶核仁與有絲分裂的紅血球前驅細胞，呈紅血球系增生，符合 PNH 溶血所致的代償反應；本身形態不具特異性。
features: Hypercellular marrow with a bony trabecula at left and scattered fat spaces
Clusters of erythroid precursors with round central nuclei, fine chromatin and occasional nucleoli (early forms) plus smaller dark normoblasts
Frequent mitotic figures within erythroid islands
Megakaryocyte present near center with lobated nucleus
Occasional granulocytic precursors/eosinophils; scattered dark granular pigment deposits
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy (H&E, high power) shows a hypercellular marrow with marked erythroid hyperplasia, composed of sheets and islands of erythroid precursors with a left shift toward early forms and frequent mitoses. Megakaryocytes are present, and granulocytic elements are relatively reduced. No infiltrate of foreign cells or fibrosis is evident in this field. The findings reflect a reactive erythroid response to hemolysis and are consistent with the clinical diagnosis of PNH, which requires flow cytometric confirmation.

ddx.dx: Pure erythroid leukemia (AML with erythroid predominance)
ddx.vs: Pure erythroid leukemia shows sheets of highly atypical proerythroblasts (≥30%) with marked dysplasia, whereas here maturation through normoblasts is preserved.
Megaloblastic change shows nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony and giant myeloid forms best seen on aspirate; B12/folate levels and absence of a GPI-deficient clone separate it.
Parvovirus produces giant pronormoblasts with glassy intranuclear inclusions and loss of later erythroid forms rather than full-spectrum erythroid hyperplasia.
Marrow morphology is identical; direct antiglobulin test, RBC morphology and FLAER flow cytometry discriminate.
